name: Lab 4.6 - Multi-Press Confirmation
description: Count raw A/B button presses in independent PLC counters and compare their accumulated counts. Reset clears both counters.

hints: Count rising edges of button_a_pressed and button_b_pressed with separate PLC CTUs. Each operator action is a one-accepted-scan pulse; clicks before the same accepted scan coalesce, rather than forming a queued click counter.

The original offline reference enables confirmation_valid only at exactly A=2 and B=3; extra presses beyond the limits remove it. These values are chosen training assumptions, not source-specified presets. Press order is unrestricted; there is no elapsed-time window.
reset_pressed inhibits both count rungs and resets both CTUs before evaluating the indication. Author or explicitly open a controller before Run; no solution is automatically loaded.

solution.summary: This is an original functional reference for the control concept, not a copy of the photographed solution.
steps: Use two PLC CTUs driven by the raw A/B inputs, each inhibited by reset_pressed.
Reset both counters before comparing their .ACC values. Publish each .ACC to its PLC-owned DINT count display.
Compare both counts in series for confirmation_valid; use exactly A=2 and B=3 for the explicit original offline reference.
Stop clears outputs and pending pulses but retains PLC counter state. Application Reset clears all state and stays stopped.
solution.acceptance: The original offline reference enables confirmation_valid only at exactly A=2 and B=3; extra presses beyond the limits remove it. These values are chosen training assumptions, not source-specified presets. Press order is unrestricted; there is no elapsed-time window.

machineGuide.purpose: Count raw A/B button presses in independent PLC counters and compare their accumulated counts. Reset clears both counters.
startConditions: Use the built-in offline controller; explicitly author or open a compatible project before Run.
Both raw press inputs and reset_pressed start false; both PLC count outputs start zero.
normalSequence: Author or explicitly open a compatible ladder project, then Run.
Press A twice and B three times, waiting for the momentary input to return false between presses.
Verify both PLC count displays and the green indication; extra presses beyond the reference limits remove the indication.
Press RESET to clear both PLC counters and the indication.
Stop clears both PLC count readouts to zero while retaining counter memory; Run republishes the retained counts. Application Reset clears counter memory and stays stopped.
stopBehavior: Stop clears command/readout outputs and pending pulses, while retaining the PLC accumulated counts.
Run republishes the retained counts without a new press. Application Reset clears everything and stays stopped.
faultBehavior: Removed precomputed inputs are incompatible with older projects. Rebind raw inputs and PLC DINT count outputs before loading.
Presses before the same accepted scan coalesce. This sampled pulse interface does not queue every rapid click and is not a high-speed hardware counter.
expectedObservations: The original offline reference enables confirmation_valid only at exactly A=2 and B=3; extra presses beyond the limits remove it. These values are chosen training assumptions, not source-specified presets. Press order is unrestricted; there is no elapsed-time window.

changedTags: Precomputed ready/pattern_ok inputs removed: the PLC now counts raw presses and performs the comparison.
